chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Biot-Savart law and its application to a current-carrying circular loop
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Circular loop centre/axis; signed current and coil turns
acceptance_tests: Independently integrate Biot-Savart and check axial limiting law; loop orientation must agree with current

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Magnetic field at the centre of a current-carrying arc
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Arc angle; connected radial segments and semicircle/full-loop limits
acceptance_tests: Check Barc=μ0Iθ/(4πR) and zero radial contribution; angle units and lead geometry are explicit

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Magnetic field due to a long straight current-carrying wire
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Wire observation on either side; finite-wire extension versus infinite limit
acceptance_tests: Check μ0I/(2πr) for long-wire model and right-hand direction; finite ends cannot silently use infinite law

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Ampere's law and its application to an infinitely long straight wire
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Circular Amperian path; enclosed versus exterior currents
acceptance_tests: Verify ∮B·dl=μ0Ienclosed under supplied symmetry; law alone cannot infer uniform field on an arbitrary path

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Ampere's law for a solenoid and a toroid
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Long solenoid interior/end limits; ideal toroid interior/exterior
acceptance_tests: Verify B=μ0nI or μ0NI/(2πr) in supported regions; J/N explicitly list solenoid but not standalone toroid, so mixed label needs scope review

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Bar magnet and magnetic field lines
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
required_variants: Bar magnet poles, external lines and return path

topic: Bar magnet as an equivalent solenoid
source_refs: J-PDF p.5 Physics U13; A-PDF p.15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.6 Physics U13
acceptance_tests: Check equivalent moment orientation and external-field relation; equivalence is not exact near-field geometry

chapter: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
topic: Magnetic field due to a magnetic dipole or bar magnet along its axis and perpendicular to its axis
